item.title: 1 killed, 2 critical after head-on collision on U.S. 301
item.description: A head-on collision that occurred just north of Marion County on U.S. Highway 301 left a woman from Jacksonville dead and two other individuals with serious injuries.

item.title: Bishop Deamontae E. Richardson
item.description: Bishop Richardson will be deeply missed by his family, and friends. His memories will live on in the hearts of his loved ones.

item.title: Ocala police seeking $161,000 for 28 new bulletproof vests
item.description: The Ocala Police Department is asking the city to approve a $161,000 purchase for 28 replacement ballistic vests for officers conducting high-risk operations, saying the old vests have a five-year life span and fibers that degrade from normal wear and tear.

item.title: Mary Eloise Stossel
item.description: Mary Stossel found great joy in obedience and agility training with the many dogs who shared her life over the years.

item.title: Residents bemoan new Home Depot, cite traffic increase on SR 200 from Sprouts and Chipotle
item.description: "I have to agree with others who have written about putting Home Depot right outside the main gate at On Top of the World (OTOW). The traffic at 99th Street and State Road 200 has increased since putting in a Sprouts and Chipotle and there is no turning light at that exit from OTOW on to SR 200. HCA also wants to put in an emergency facility also right outside our gate. Are the people who plan these things not considering how we as OTOW residents feel about this? Traffic is already a nightmare"

item.title: Elliott LeRoy Deese
item.description: Elliott Deese loved to fish, hunt, ride his motorcycles, listen to country music bands, tell stories of his past, make people laugh, and most of all spend time with family.

item.title: City may spend $245,725 on security cameras at key Ocala facilities
item.description: The city is looking to spend $245,725 on new and replacement security cameras and CCTV equipment to improve physical security controls at several key facilities around Ocala.

item.description: Check out this beautiful sunrise from Ocala. Thanks to Orlando Camacho for sharing!

item.title: Woman sues AdventHealth Ocala over slip-and-fall in parking lot
item.description: A Marion County woman who requires the assistance of a walker has filed a lawsuit against AdventHealth Ocala, claiming her walker allegedly got caught on a broken brick paver while she was traversing a walking path in the parking lot.

item.title: I drive SR 200 several hours daily and it is safer now because of the medians
item.description: "I have seen letter after letter after letter complaining about the changes on State Road 200 and it's clear these are retirees who do not travel these roads every day.
